stale_triggers: the binding resolves to a different repository, checkout or worktree
the stable project or repository identity no longer matches the stored binding
a consumer uses a moved branch name or filesystem path as the durable source identity
recovery: create a new binding version and re-resolve the checkout
recapture dependent Source Snapshots and propagate stale closure without overwriting prior bindings
acceptance: the same binding fields resolve to the same repository and checkout identity
a different checkout or worktree has a different binding identity even when it shares a commit
branch name and repository path are not accepted as the sole durable identity
out_of_scope: treating a branch name as authority

stale_triggers: base, HEAD, index, tracked content, included untracked content or dependency lock changes
a required untracked file is absent from the manifest
the actual dirty state differs from the recorded state
the Repository Binding becomes stale
the manifest or exclusion rule cannot be reproduced
recovery: capture a new complete content manifest from the current binding
preserve the prior snapshot and mark dependent Context, Verification, review, Decision and artifact records stale
resolve omitted or unexplained files before starting a new Run
acceptance: the same normalized manifest and dependency identity produce the same snapshot identity
changing each identity field independently rejects reuse of the prior snapshot
dirty, staged and untracked states are represented explicitly
excluded files have a fixed rule and reason
out_of_scope: proving semantic correctness from a digest
using commit SHA alone for a dirty worktree

stale_triggers: the base or candidate Source Snapshot changes
the actual file or symbol delta differs from the recorded delta
change semantics, Work Item or Contract binding changes
a merge result differs from the candidate that was verified
a dependency or conflict-domain decision changes
recovery: derive a new Change Set from fixed base and candidate snapshots
rerun impact closure, selected verification and integration checks
preserve superseded and split or merged Change Sets as history
acceptance: the same base and candidate snapshots produce the same normalized change identity
add, modify, delete and rename are not conflated
the Change Set is traceable to its Work Item, Contract and change semantics
a different merge result cannot reuse the prior Verification or Decision
out_of_scope: using branch names as the change identity
assuming line count defines semantic scope

stale_triggers: the bound Source Snapshot or Change Set changes
test selection, command, workflow, environment or toolchain meaning changes
raw output or Evidence digest does not match
a CI result targets a different commit or manifest
a required Test is omitted or the selection oracle becomes stale
a retry is presented as an overwrite of the prior Attempt
recovery: start a new Attempt or Run against the current fixed Snapshot and Change Set
recapture raw output and validate it before deriving Evidence
rerun required full or affected tests after selection or environment changes
retain prior local and CI Attempts without converting provider green status directly into acceptance
acceptance: local and CI runs use the same logical fields and remain distinct provider records
the result can be reproduced or audited from the fixed source, command or workflow, environment and raw output
a result for another source identity is rejected
retry and rerun create new Attempt identities
out_of_scope: CI green as the sole acceptance oracle

stale_triggers: artifact content differs from its digest
source, Change Set, build Run, toolchain or target platform changes
a required Verification Run becomes stale or does not target the artifact source
promotion or rollback references a different artifact identity
recovery: rebuild from the current fixed source and toolchain
rerun required Verification for the target platform
create a new artifact and promotion record while preserving the prior rollback target
acceptance: artifact digest and source-to-build-to-verification chain are complete
promotion and rollback resolve the same immutable artifact identities
release cannot use an artifact whose source or Verification is stale
out_of_scope: release approval from artifact existence alone

stale_when: source or test execution identity changes
required selected or full Test evidence is missing
target_consistency_gates.recovery: run a new Verification Attempt against the current fixed source

stale_when: reviewed source, scope, criteria, materials or required Verification changes
target_consistency_gates.recovery: recompute scope and perform a new review or affected review against the current source

stale_when: the approved target content, Evidence, authority scope or acceptance truth changes
target_consistency_gates.recovery: request a new Human Decision bound to the new target and Evidence digests

stale_when: the commit tree differs from the accepted Source Snapshot or includes an unverified Change Set
target_consistency_gates.recovery: capture the commit tree as a new Snapshot and rerun required Verification before integration

stale_when: source, build, Verification, target platform, promotion or artifact content differs
target_consistency_gates.recovery: rebuild, reverify and issue a new promotion Decision while retaining rollback provenance

initial_scope: read-only local Git capture of repository, base, HEAD, index, tracked changes and included untracked files
negative fixtures for source mismatch, omitted untracked files, dirty-state mismatch and stale evidence
identity and relation fields needed for later CI and Build Artifact work
deferred_scope: CI adapter until local deployment E2E and a real project need exist
Build Artifact implementation and promotion until Work 7B
Git hosting operations, push, pull request creation, merge queue and CI initiation
bounded parallel execution until fixed source, conflict domain, owner or lease and integration checkpoint are verified
global_rules: commit SHA alone is insufficient for a dirty or partially selected worktree
branch name is a movable reference and not a durable identity
old Evidence remains immutable and becomes stale rather than being overwritten
displayed CI success does not become ReviewCompass3 acceptance without source and Evidence validation
optional CI does not block a project whose acceptance uses local Verification
specific Git hosting and CI provider operations are not initial Requirements
approved_effect: none until a Human Decision is bound to this candidate digest
